title: Validate Duplex DataModel against IFC4 schema
description: Loads the Duplex IFC DataModel and runs `inspectDataModel` from `dataModelInspector` against a curated IFC4 `DataFormatSchema`. Every opt-in check is enabled — schema tagging, relationship type binding (with super-type-aware matching against `IfcObjectDefinition`), and `IfcRelAggregates` cycle detection. The InspectionReport renders into a three-tier panel: severity counts in the header, one collapsible group per issue code with its plain-English description, and per-issue rows inside.
